title: Sign up for small business training

paragraphs: The City funds nonprofit organizations to provide small business training and one-on-one counseling.

sections.heading: Training Providers
paragraphs: Below is a list of organizations that offer pre-qualified trainings for the Business Training Grant . Please visit their websites or contact them directly for more information.
